name: A10-0300/2026 – Pierre Pimpie – After recital E – Am 2
title: REPORT on the implementation of the VAT reverse-charge mechanism
part_text: Ea. whereas unanimity in matters of fiscal policy is essential to preserving Member States’ national sovereignty, as it ensures that decisions affecting taxation and public expenditure are adopted only with the consent of all Member States, thereby safeguarding democratic accountability and ensuring that the different economic circumstances and national priorities of each Member State are duly taken into account;
